subject: Quote HAM-HKG incl. insurance
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

please quote 4 cases of watch movements Hamburg (HAM) to Hong Kong (HKG), 620 kg, 2.4 cbm, ready 27.11., delivered to HAM by us. Cheapest option in EUR.

The goods are worth EUR 180,000. Please include cargo insurance for the full value in your offer, or tell us its cost separately.

Best regards
Clara Goldschmidt
Managing Director
Goldschmidt Uhren GmbH
